purpose: Versioned registry of reusable Lab capabilities. Draft only: no runtime effect until a tool or validator consumes it.

capabilities.purpose: Normalize reviewed human or file-derived input into a domain-adapted card before admin review.
use_when: A visitor or expert provides material that may help a Lab.
The input needs source, boundary and review before contamination.
do_not_use_when: The input is a secret or sensitive private dataset.
The operator wants direct seed mutation.
security_boundary: Do not store secrets.
Do not promote submitted material automatically.
capabilities.valid_when: A domain adapter can render the card with source, missing data, null/baseline or falsifier.
capabilities.retire_when: The card becomes a shortcut for unreviewed opinions.

capabilities.purpose: Turn expert language, screenshots, PDFs or notes into method definitions, missing questions and falsifiers.
use_when: Domain experts provide informal method material.
Terms are ambiguous and need operational definitions.
do_not_use_when: The material is treated as authority.
The method cannot name what it measures.
security_boundary: Unverified experts are not authoritative.
Attachments remain quarantined until review.
capabilities.valid_when: The card exposes source, object, rule, invalidation and falsifier or declares what is missing.
capabilities.retire_when: It converts expert language into claims without mechanical definition.

capabilities.purpose: Expose current data/value artifacts to UI and THIA before a cognitive cycle interprets them.
use_when: The domain reads external or time-varying data.
The dashboard needs fresh context without running a full cycle.
do_not_use_when: The artifact would be interpreted as a claim by itself.
The source cannot be traced.
security_boundary: Public/no-key data preferred for public demo.
No credentials in artifacts.
capabilities.valid_when: The artifact can be inspected without granting interpretive authority.
capabilities.retire_when: The artifact becomes a hidden dependency or a public claim.

capabilities.purpose: Refresh data outside the agent cycle so the cycle reads deterministic artifacts.
use_when: Network behavior may differ inside agent/runtime.
The cycle should reason over visible artifact state.
do_not_use_when: The refresh has side effects not visible in artifacts.
The source requires secrets in public context.
security_boundary: No secret-bearing requests unless explicitly authorized.
Refresh failure must not silently reuse stale data.
capabilities.valid_when: The cycle can cite the artifact as its data surface.
capabilities.retire_when: The script becomes an opaque fetch hidden from UI and THIA.

capabilities.purpose: Require events or data labels to survive source/provider disagreement checks.
use_when: Multiple sources/providers can describe the same object.
Single-source artifacts can create false events.
do_not_use_when: Only one source exists and the limitation is already explicit.
The gate hides source disagreement instead of showing it.
security_boundary: Provider errors must not be hidden.
A gate failure must block promotion.
capabilities.valid_when: Source disagreement downgrades or blocks claims before interpretation.
capabilities.retire_when: The gate becomes decorative and claims still promote.

capabilities.purpose: Classify scales/timeframes as testable, watch or blocked using denominators and domain checks.
use_when: The domain has multi-scale observations.
The scale itself changes admissibility.
do_not_use_when: The scale is only a display preference.
No denominator or null can be defined per scale.
security_boundary: A testable scale is not an operational signal.
Blocked scales must remain visible.
capabilities.valid_when: The matrix selects admissible test surfaces without predicting outcomes.
capabilities.retire_when: It becomes a best-timeframe opinion engine.

capabilities.purpose: Test components separately before accepting a combined/confluence narrative.
use_when: A claim depends on multiple interacting indicators or sources.
A combination may hide that one component carries all value.
do_not_use_when: Components cannot be separated without changing the object.
The confluence is only visual copy.
security_boundary: Do not promote narrative confluence without ablation.
Keep failed components visible.
capabilities.valid_when: The confluence survives component ablations or is downgraded.
capabilities.retire_when: It is used to decorate already chosen claims.

capabilities.purpose: Hold external/public/operator inputs outside seed and cycle authority until review.
use_when: Any input arrives from visitor, expert, operator notes or imported sources.
The input could affect Lab state.
do_not_use_when: The data is already a committed domain artifact.
The operator explicitly performs a reviewed seed update.
security_boundary: Never write public contribution directly to seed.
Reject secrets and sensitive personal data.
capabilities.valid_when: The input is visible for review but has no Lab authority.
capabilities.retire_when: Quarantine records are treated as accepted evidence.

capabilities.purpose: Expose forbidden operational/advice outputs in high-risk domains.
use_when: A domain could be mistaken for financial, medical, legal or operational advice.
Outputs may influence real-world decisions.
do_not_use_when: The domain has no sensitive decision surface and a lighter boundary is enough.
security_boundary: Block advice/signal language before publication or promotion.
capabilities.valid_when: The Lab can explain what cannot be done with current evidence.
capabilities.retire_when: Boundary text exists but prohibited outputs still appear.

capabilities.purpose: Keep THIA grounded in active domain, tab, role and current artifact state, while providing reusable assistant/intake behavior through domain adapters.
use_when: A page exposes Lab state to visitors or operators.
THIA must distinguish explain, clarify, review, contact/support and contribute.
A generated Lab needs an assistant profile without copying another Lab's domain language.
do_not_use_when: No domain context is available.
The assistant is being used for generic site copy.
The target surface cannot provide role boundary and review quarantine.
security_boundary: Do not expose admin-only data to public visitors.
Do not claim Lab state changed unless it did.
Do not reuse BTC/Finance/sensitive-domain language outside its adapter.
Do not persist secrets or private corpus through public intake.
capabilities.valid_when: THIA answers from current Lab context and role.
capabilities.retire_when: THIA behaves as generic chatbot, confuses visitor/admin, or imports another Lab's domain language.

capabilities.purpose: Render review cards in admin as readable Markdown while preserving source text.
use_when: A card is better reviewed as structured text than raw JSON.
do_not_use_when: Markdown would hide raw source or extraction limits.
security_boundary: Render safe subset only.
Do not execute embedded HTML.
capabilities.valid_when: Review is more legible without losing source trace.
capabilities.retire_when: Rendering obscures what was actually submitted.

capabilities.purpose: Require every external input or artifact to carry source, origin and limitation metadata.
use_when: Any imported, public, expert or generated material enters a Lab surface.
do_not_use_when: The material is purely internal code with git provenance.
security_boundary: Unknown source cannot promote.
Private or secret-bearing source must be blocked or quarantined.
capabilities.valid_when: Users can tell where an input came from and what is missing.
capabilities.retire_when: Source metadata is present but ignored by promotion gates.

capabilities.purpose: Prevent assistant/UI flows from confusing visitor, expert, admin, operator and Lab agent roles.
use_when: A public or admin assistant can save, review, explain or suggest actions.
do_not_use_when: The interface has only one authenticated operator role and no public surface.
security_boundary: Visitors cannot be treated as admin.
Experts cannot be treated as verified authority by default.
capabilities.valid_when: The assistant states and behaves according to the correct role.
capabilities.retire_when: Role text is present but actions cross privilege boundaries.

capabilities.purpose: Detect and block or redact common secrets before persistence, packet or publication.
use_when: Public input, file intake, operator notes or generated docs may be persisted.
do_not_use_when: A human is intentionally editing private local configuration outside Lab surfaces.
security_boundary: Never display or commit detected secrets.
Prefer block over silent unsafe persistence.
capabilities.valid_when: Secret-like material is not persisted or echoed.
capabilities.retire_when: The guard creates false confidence and secrets still pass.
